params.description: Cursor timestamp for pagination (created_at of last item from previous page)

params.name: cursor_id
params.description: Cursor ID for pagination (id of last item from previous page)

params.name: asset_path
params.description: Filter by asset path (case-insensitive partial match)

params.description: Filter by usage path (case-insensitive partial match)

params.name: asset_kinds
params.description: Filter by asset kinds (multiple values allowed)

params.name: columns
params.description: JSONB subset match filter for columns using base64 encoded JSON

params.name: broad_filter
params.description: broad search across multiple fields (case-insensitive substring match)
